headword: {頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い
reading: あたまのかいてんがはやい

definitions.gloss: quick-witted; sharp-minded; quick on the uptake
definitions.explanation: Describes a person who thinks fast, understands quickly, and responds well in the moment. A common and natural-sounding compliment.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い。
{頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}いから、{何|なに}を{聞|き}いてもすぐに{答|こた}えられる。
examples.english: She's so sharp that she can answer any question right away.

examples.japanese: {営業|えいぎょう}の{仕事|しごと}では、{頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い{人|ひと}が{活躍|かつやく}しやすい。
examples.english: In sales, quick-thinking people tend to do well.

notes:
Literally "the rotation of the head is fast." A vivid metaphor comparing quick thinking to a fast-spinning mechanism. Very natural and commonly used as a compliment. The opposite is {頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{遅|おそ}い (slow-witted), which is considered rude.

FORMS:
- {頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{速|はや}い: quick-witted (positive)
- {頭|あたま}の{回転|かいてん}が{遅|おそ}い: slow-witted (negative/rude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頭|あたま}がいい: smart, intelligent — a more general compliment about intelligence
- {機転|きてん}が{利|き}く: resourceful, quick-thinking — emphasizes practical cleverness in the moment
- {切|き}れ{者|もの}: a sharp person — a noun describing someone notably clever and capable
